book.title: The Complete Novels
book.description: Witty, wise, enduring and treasured, the seven great novels of Jane Austen Few novelists have conveyed the subtleties and nuances of their own social milieu with the wit and insight of Jane Austen. Through her vivacious and spirited heroines and their circle, she paints vivid portraits of English middle-class life as the eighteenth century came to a close. The seven novels in this omnibus edition contain some of the most brilliant, dazzling prose in the English language. Sense and Sensibility Pride and Prejudice Mansfiled Park Emma Northanger Abbey Persuasion Lady Susan
